title: Plus One Linked List
description:
Given a non-negative integer represented as a non-empty singly linked list of decimal digits (with the **most significant digit** at `head` and no leading zeros except for the number `0` itself), add `1` to the integer and return the head of the resulting linked list.

Aim for `O(n)` time and `O(1)` extra space.
constraints: The number of nodes in the list is in the range [1, 10^4].
The integer does not contain leading zeros except when it is 0 itself.
hints: You can reverse the list, add 1 with carry propagation, and reverse back in O(n) time and O(1) space.
Even better, attach a sentinel `0` node before `head` and find the rightmost node whose value is not `9`; increment that node by 1 and set every trailing `9` after it to `0`.
